name: dragons_lair_20th
title: Dragon's Lair 20th Anniversary Edition (Digital Leisure, DVD)

notes.text: A move is a window of ~1 s over a playing clip with five auto-action buttons: b1 centre (Nop, the forced select), b2 up, b3 right, b4 down, b5 left. One arrow tap fires the move: no Select (move_key.responses sets no_select).
notes.why: A Select after a link move lands on whatever the jump brought up.

notes.text: The title PRE sets g[1] = 10000. A sword/action button only SETs g[0] above it and the cell command judges it ('if (g[0] < g[1]) LinkPTT <death>'), like Mad Dog's shots; a wrong direction links straight to a death clip in the same PGC; doing nothing falls into the death test or into the NEXT window (one action can be three consecutive windows, each with its own right button: title 3 cells 43-45, 46-48, 49-51).
notes.why: move_key: doing nothing is followed past every later window; the death is the place most options pass through.

notes.text: From a cold start the death handler (CallSS VMGM pgc 2) restarts title 2's scene (cell 72), whatever title died: the rig, mid-game, goes elsewhere. moves_right therefore judges by the FIRST cell after the window (the death clip, e.g. cell 54, vs the story's next cell, e.g. 55), which is local to the PGC.
notes.why: The Weakest Link lesson: paths from a cold start name places a mid-game rig never visits.

notes.text: Power-on: title menu (VMGM PGC 1) Play = b1; options screen (VTS 19) defaults Arcade / Original / Easy / Unlimited lives, Play = b9; the game intro (VTS 1 cell 1, ~58 s) has one button that skips it (b1). Route [1, 9, 1].
notes.why: Unlimited lives keeps a wrong move from ending the run; the skip saves a minute per run.

play.description: Start a game (Play, Play: unlimited lives) and make every keyed move as its window arms: every move must land on the right option's next cell.

play_wrong.description: The control arm of 'play': the same run pressing a WRONG option at every keyed move (move_key pick='wrong'). moves_right must FAIL here, or it cannot tell a death from a survival.
